checkpoint_decision.reasons: DreamShaper wins 2/3 criteria on the floor tile subject but loses 2/3 on the wheel prop subject, with an actual composition regression (a retained shadow-blob artifact and a stray axle appendage) on 2/2 of its wheel images after the rembg cutout step. D-01c requires a win on >=2/3 criteria WITH NO composition regression before adopting; the wheel subject's regression disqualifies adoption even though the floor subject alone would have passed. Kept env_checkpoint=sdxl_base. DreamShaper is also ~65% slower per image on this machine (checkpoint-swap + generation), a secondary cost of adopting it. The downloaded+verified dreamshaperXL_alpha2Xl10.safetensors is left in place for a future per-subject override (env_subjects entries may still set checkpoint_profile later) or a revisit once its prop-cutout behavior is investigated further.
